output.summary: KEP-2394 proposes building support for the out-of-tree AWS cloud provider, centered on a well-tested cloud-controller-manager with feature parity to kube-controller-manager. The KEP is currently in provisional status.
output.rationale: Clusters on AWS run the in-tree cloud provider, and the KEP aims to move that to an out-of-tree cloud-controller-manager. The motivation is deferred to the Cloud Controller Manager KEP, and this KEP tracks AWS-specific progress. Removing in-tree AWS code is explicitly out of scope and falls under the removing-in-tree-providers KEP. The sources give no reasoning for the provisional status.

alternatives.option: Removing the in-tree AWS cloud provider code within this KEP
alternatives.why_not: The readme lists it as a non-goal, stating it 'falls under the KEP for removing in-tree providers'.

evidence.quote: Build support for the out-of-tree AWS cloud provider. This involves a well-tested version of the cloud-controller-manager
This KEP is specifically tracking progress for the AWS cloud provider.
Removing in-tree AWS cloud provider code, this effort falls under the [KEP for removing in-tree providers]
